about: A measured constant and no ceiling anywhere.

files.model.yaml:
dsl: 1
model: tiny
title: No ceiling
currency: USD

nodes:

  request_rate:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: request/second
    value: 200
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the busy hour, as stated for this case"}

  service_demand:
    kind: input
    decided: outside
    unit: core*second/request
    value: 0.02
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "processor time per request, as stated for this case"}

  cores:
    kind: input
    decided: you
    unit: core
    value: 16
    provenance: {kind: assumption, source: "the fleet chosen for this case"}

  busy_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: request_rate * service_demand

  utilisation:
    kind: derived
    unit: dimensionless
    formula: busy_cores / cores

  compression:
    kind: measured
    unit: dimensionless
    result: records-compression

  compressed_cores:
    kind: derived
    unit: core
    formula: busy_cores / compression

outputs:
  - utilisation
  - compressed_cores
files.scenarios/reference.yaml:
scenario: reference
title: Reference
because: the model as declared
samples: 1000
seed: 20260916
overrides: {}

provenance.source: the fleet chosen for this case
the busy hour, as stated for this case
processor time per request, as stated for this case

problems.message: _builder_conformance/measured-without-ceiling/model.yaml: has measured constants but no ceiling. A model with empirical inputs and no declared limit is claiming that nothing in it changes regime — which may be true, and should be stated by declaring the ceiling and its headroom rather than by leaving it out.
